witness_semantics: witness/<aid>.py runs the artifact's solve.py, then independently checks: W2 warehouse capacity conditioned on activation; W3 every store's demand met exactly; W4 non-negative shipments; W5 reported objective equals recomputed cost with TRUE fixed costs (tol 1e-6); W6 activation: warehouse ships >0 iff open flag==1.

c3_no_link.description: C3 activation error: ship-to-open-flag link dropped; optimizer keeps y=0 everywhere, pays no fixed fee. Feasible, cheaper; violates activation rule.
